description: This file defines the LeavePeriodAPI class, which provides REST API endpoints for managing and retrieving leave period data within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for getting current and all leave periods, updating leave periods, and handles related business logic and validation.

classes.name: LeavePeriodAPI
classes.description: This class provides API endpoints to retrieve current leave period data, list all leave periods, and update leave period settings in the OrangeHRM system. It implements CRUD functionalities and integrates with various services and models for leave period management.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Retrieves the current leave period along with its history and status, returning a resource result containing leave period data and metadata.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns a list of all generated leave periods, with metadata indicating if a leave period is defined and which is current.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates or creates a leave period with the provided start month and day, saves the data, and optionally enables menu items if previously undefined.
